name: board_list
description: Read the shared Kanban board: every column and every card, with its subtasks, dependencies, deadline, assignee, activity log and accrued cost. The board is at state/board.json and every clanker sees the same one.

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room

who.description: Show only cards this clanker is concerned with: assigned to them, assigned or created by them, or unclaimed. A view filter, not a permission; everyone in the room can read every card.
